state_semantics.meaning: A successful collection containing an admitted record; not a source-truth label.
A completed bounded exact-identifier lookup returned no matching record; not zero or universal absence.
The source or configured offline snapshot was unavailable at collection time; distinct from no_record.
Policy, admission, kill-switch or transport control prevented the action, often before connector invocation.
Identity, cutoff/window, manifest, media, fact, schema, locator or semantic contract failed validation.
A terminal collection or persistence failure retained for review rather than rewritten as pass or zero.

limitations: The exhibit reports implementation and local synthetic test evidence only; it contains no live Companies House or UKRI retrieval and no official-adapter comparison.
A capability manifest, version, checksum, locator, request fingerprint or derivation hash supports deterministic traceability and contract checking, not source truth, correctness or completeness.
No-record is bounded to an exact identifier, source snapshot/response and request window; it is not a universal absence finding and is never zero.
Unavailable, blocked, invalid, failure, missing, held and conflict states remain distinct; none is promoted to supported evidence without its own contract-satisfying record.
The public-web path is a separate conditioned engineering boundary and does not silently admit or substitute for held direct registry adapters.
No coverage, latency, cost, user benefit, source quality, production availability, legal authority, causality, valuation or investment recommendation is claimed.
